Ben and Mia name the cat Dusty. Dusty likes her new garden home. Luna the Owl smiles. "You are good friends to animals," she says. It is a great day for the family.

articles.title: A Walk to the Market
articles.summary: Walking to the local market is a fun way for children to see colorful fruits, hear happy sounds, and meet friendly people in their town.
articles.passage:
A walk to the local market is very fun. Many children walk there with their parents. The street is safe, wide, and clean. On the street, you can see tall green trees. You can see birds in the trees. You can also see friendly dogs and slow cars. It is a very easy walk. This short walk is a great start to the day.

Next, you arrive at the busy market. The market has many bright colors. There are big red apples and sweet yellow bananas. You can see green pears and orange carrots. You can see beautiful flowers in blue pots. The market is also very loud. Sellers call out to the people. They sell fresh food and warm bread. Shoppers talk, laugh, and smile. Friendly people help you carry heavy bags.

In short, a walk to the market is a great activity. You can see beautiful sights on the way. You can hear many happy sounds. It is a very good way to see your town. You can buy good food for your family. Every local market is a special place for children.

articles.title: A Week of Weather
articles.summary: Weather changes every day and helps us choose what to wear and do.
articles.passage:
The weather changes every day. Sometimes it is sunny and hot. Sometimes it is rainy and cold. A week has seven days. In one week, the sky can look very different. Let's look at weather changes.

Monday and Tuesday can be sunny. The big sun is in the blue sky. It is very hot outside. Children wear hats and t-shirts. They play football in the park. They can also swim in the pool. Sunny days are good for playing.

Wednesday and Thursday can be rainy. The sky is grey and dark. Many clouds are in the air. Water falls from the sky. Children use umbrellas to stay dry. They wear boots and raincoats. This water is good for the green grass.

Friday and Saturday can be windy. The wind blows the leaves. It is a bit cold. People wear jackets and trousers. They can fly a kite in the wind. The trees move a lot. It is not a good day for a picnic.

Sunday is the last day of the week. The weather can change again. It is fun to watch the sky. We check the weather every morning. This helps us choose our clothes. Every kind of weather is special.

articles.title: Bees are Great Helpers
articles.summary: Bees are small insects that help flowers grow and make sweet honey.
articles.passage:
Bees are small and busy insects. They live in green gardens and parks. You see them in the garden. You can see bees in the spring. They fly in the warm sun. Bees live in a very big family. They work hard every day. They love bright flowers and trees. They have six legs and four wings. They make a soft hum sound.

Bees help our nature in many ways. Bees fly to different colorful flowers. They look for sweet food. They get yellow dust on their legs. This yellow dust is pollen. Bees carry this pollen to other flowers. This simple help is very important. It helps new plants and flowers grow. Many plants have nice fruit. Bees help these plants too. We need these plants for food.

Bees also make sweet honey. They store honey in their home. This home is a hive. Honey is food for the baby bees. Humans also like to eat sweet honey. We can see bees on warm summer days. Bees are great friends of nature. We must protect these small helpers. They make our world a beautiful place.

articles.title: Ben and the Magic Owl
articles.summary: Ben is sad because his math homework is hard, but Luna the Owl helps him count with apples.
articles.passage:
Ben sits at his small desk in the classroom. He has a big, green math book. He looks at the numbers on the page. The numbers are very hard for him. Ben is sad and tired today. He wants to go to the park. He wants to play with his friends. But he has a lot of homework. He sits and he thinks. He says, "I cannot do this work."

Suddenly, a beautiful bird flies into the room. It is Luna the Learning Owl. She is blue and white. She has very big, yellow eyes. "Hello Ben," she says with a kind voice. "Why are you sad?" Ben looks up and says, "My math homework is very hard." Luna smiles at him. She has five small, red apples in her bag. She puts the apples on the desk. "Let's count these," she says.

Ben counts the red apples with Luna. One, two, three, four, and five. Now he understands the numbers. The math is easy now! Ben writes the answers in his green book. He finishes all his homework quickly. He is very happy and proud. Luna is happy too. Ben says, "Thank you for your help, Luna." Luna flies away into the sky. Ben is ready for his lesson tomorrow.

articles.title: Ben Helps in the Shop
articles.summary: Ben helps his busy mum make delicious sandwiches in her shop.
articles.passage:
Ben likes to help his mum. Mum has a small, beautiful sandwich shop. The shop is in the busy town. Today is Saturday. Many people come to the shop. They want to buy lunch. They are very hungry. Mum is very busy. She makes many cold drinks and warm food. Ben wants to help. "Can I help you, Mum?" Ben asks. "Yes, please," Mum says.

Ben washes his hands with soap. He gets the soft white bread. He puts fresh red tomato on the bread. He adds some yellow cheese. Then, he puts green salad on top. Ben is very fast and neat. Mum smiles at Ben. "You are a wonderful helper," she says. They make ten big sandwiches together. The small shop smells very good.

A kind man buys a big sandwich. He sits at a table. He takes a big bite. "This is very good!" he says. Many people eat their lunch. They all smile and laugh. Soon, the busy shop is quiet. Mum gives Ben a sweet red apple. Ben is happy. He loves to help his mum in her shop.

articles.title: Bike Riding is Fun
articles.summary: Riding a bike is a fun and safe hobby when you wear a helmet and ride with family in a park.
articles.passage:
Bike riding is a very fun hobby. Many children like to ride bikes. You can ride near your home. A park is a great place. The park has long, flat paths. These paths do not have cars. Cars are loud and fast. Paths are safe for young riders. You can see trees and flowers. You can hear nice birds sing. Riding in the park is beautiful.

Safety is very important for bike riding. You must always wear a helmet. A strong helmet protects your head. You can choose a colorful helmet. You also need to wear closed shoes. Do not wear loose pants. Always ride with your family or friends. Your parents can watch you. You can ride together on sunny days. It is fun to share this hobby. You can learn from each other.

There are simple rules on the path. You must look left and right. You must stop for other people. Use a bell to say hello. Riding a bike is great exercise. It makes your legs strong. It also makes you feel happy. Find a safe path near home today. Wear your helmet and start riding. Bike riding is a wonderful hobby.

articles.title: Birds in the Park
articles.summary: Birds in the local park are beautiful, interesting, and fun for children to watch.
articles.passage:
Many beautiful birds live in our local park. Children can see them every day. The park has tall trees and green grass. These trees are safe homes for the birds. The birds fly in the blue sky. They also sit on the wooden benches. It is fun to watch them play. Some birds are green and some are blue.

First, we can see grey pigeons. Pigeons are big and friendly. They walk on the grey paths. They look for small bread crumbs and seeds. They are not scared of children. Second, we can see wild ducks. Ducks live in the park pond. They swim in the cool water. They have bright orange feet. Ducks make loud, funny sounds. Third, we can see tiny sparrows. Sparrows are brown and white. They are very fast. They fly from bush to bush. Sparrows sing sweet songs in the morning. They love to eat small bugs.

In short, park birds are very interesting. They are busy all day. They fly, swim, and sing beautiful songs. Children can learn a lot from these birds. We must protect their green homes. They make our world a happy place.

articles.title: Buying Fresh Food at the Market
articles.summary: The local market is a great place to buy fresh, healthy food.
articles.passage:
A local market is a busy place. People go there to buy fresh food. You can see many small shops there. Farmers bring their food to the market every morning. The food is very healthy and clean. It is a great place to visit with your family.

You can find many bright colors here. Red apples and yellow bananas look very nice. Green vegetables are fresh and good for you. You can smell sweet oranges and soft pears. Friendly sellers are happy to show their food. They always help you choose the best fruits. You can put the fresh food in your big basket. Everything is clean and ready to eat now.

Many kind people work at the market. You can ask them for help easily. They sell good food with a warm smile. You can pay the seller with some money. Then you carry your heavy basket back home. You can cook a delicious meal now. Fresh food makes your body strong and active. The local market is useful for every town. It helps us stay healthy and happy. We love to buy food at the market.

articles.title: Caring for a Classroom Pet
articles.summary: Caring for a classroom rabbit is fun and teaches children how to be kind helpers.
articles.passage:
Many schools have a classroom pet. A small rabbit is a great pet. It is very cute and friendly. The rabbit needs food and water. It needs clean water every day. It also eats fresh green grass. It eats sweet orange carrots too. Children can feed the rabbit every morning. Feeding the rabbit is an easy job. It makes the rabbit very happy.

The rabbit lives in a big cage. The cage has soft yellow straw inside. Students must clean the cage every week. A clean cage keeps the rabbit healthy. It also stops bad smells. Children can play with the rabbit. They must be quiet and gentle. Do not make loud noises. Do not run near the rabbit. Loud noises make the rabbit scared.

Caring for a classroom pet is very fun. It teaches children to be very kind. It also helps children learn new things. Students work together to help the animal. They talk about the rabbit. They write about the rabbit. They learn to be good helpers. A healthy rabbit is a great friend. It brings big joy to the classroom every day.

articles.title: Choosing the Right Clothes
articles.summary: We choose different clothes for different weather to stay comfortable and healthy throughout the year.
articles.passage: The weather changes many times every year. Some days are very sunny and hot. Other days are very cold and windy. We need to choose the right clothes. This helps us stay comfortable all day. It is important to look at the sky. In the summer, the sun is very strong. The weather is hot and often dry. Children like to wear light clothes. They wear thin T-shirts and short trousers. They also wear hats to protect their faces. These clothes keep us cool and happy. In the winter, the weather is very cold. The wind is often strong and chilly. We must wear thick and warm clothes. People wear heavy coats and long sweaters. They also use soft scarves and warm gloves. This keeps our bodies very warm. Rainy days are often very wet and grey. We need special clothes for the water. We wear long raincoats and rubber boots. These boots keep our feet dry. We also carry a large umbrella. It is fun to walk in the rain. Choosing the right clothes is very useful. It helps us stay healthy and safe. We can play outside in the sun or rain. We are ready for any kind of weather. Good clothes make every day a happy day.

articles.title: Cooking Pancakes with an Adult
articles.summary: You can help an adult make delicious pancakes at home by mixing ingredients in a bowl, waiting safely while they cook, and adding sweet toppings.
articles.passage:
Making pancakes at home is very fun. You can help an adult in the kitchen. First, you get a big blue bowl. You put dry flour, white milk, and eggs in the bowl. An adult helps you measure the milk. You mix everything with a big spoon. The mixture becomes very smooth and sweet. Mixing is an easy and fun job for children.

Next, the adult turns on the hot stove. Cooking needs a hot pan and some yellow butter. The adult pours the wet mixture into the warm pan. Stand back because the pan is very hot. Soon, you can see small bubbles on the pancake. The adult flips the pancake over. Now, the pancake is beautiful and golden. You can choose nice toppings for your pancake. You can put sweet yellow bananas, red strawberries, or warm honey on top.

Finally, the warm pancakes are ready to eat. You can share the delicious food with your family. Eating together is a very happy time. Then, you can help clean the table and wash the small bowls. Cooking pancakes with an adult is a great morning activity for everyone.

articles.title: Day and Night
articles.summary: Daytime is for playing and working, while night-time is for resting and sleeping.
articles.passage:
Our beautiful world has day and night. Everyday, we see these two times. The day starts in the morning. The big sun comes up. It makes the blue sky bright. The sun is warm and yellow. It gives light to the plants. We wake up and eat breakfast. Children walk to their school. People work in the busy town. We can play outdoor games. The daytime is very active.

In the evening, the sun goes down. The sky becomes dark and cool. This is the start of night-time. We can see the white moon. We also see many little stars. The stars shine like small lights. Most animals go to sleep now. Birds sit quietly in their trees. The streets are very silent. People stay inside their warm homes. They watch television or read books.

Day and night are very different. But we need both of them. Daytime is great for work and play. We learn many new things. Night-time is great for quiet rest. Our bodies need sleep to grow. Sleep helps us feel happy and strong. The sun and moon are beautiful. They make our daily lives complete.

articles.title: Drawing is Fun!
articles.summary: Drawing is a fun and easy hobby that children can enjoy anywhere.
articles.passage:
Drawing is a fun hobby for children. Many girls and boys love to draw every day. You can draw at home in your room. You can draw at school in your classroom. It is a very easy activity. You do not need expensive things. You can start this hobby right now.

First, you only need simple tools. You need clean paper and a pencil. You can also use colorful crayons. You can use markers or paint too. Second, you can draw many different things. Some children draw cute animals. They draw happy cats and big dogs. Other children draw their family and friends. You can draw your favorite toys. Third, drawing is good for you. It helps your hands move well. It also makes your brain happy. You can show your pictures to your teacher. Your teacher will like your art.

In conclusion, drawing is a great hobby. It is a quiet activity. You can do it on a rainy day. You can do it on a sunny day. You can do it anytime. You can do it anywhere. It is a wonderful way to play. Grab a pencil and draw a picture today!

articles.title: Eating Together with Family
articles.summary: Families help each other and talk while they eat meals together.
articles.passage:
Many families eat meals together every day. It is a special time for everyone. People eat breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It helps a family stay close and happy.

First, a family prepares the food. Children can help their parents in the kitchen. They wash the green vegetables with water. They also put the plates and spoons on the big table. This work is fun and helpful.

Next, the family shares the meal. Everyone sits down together in the dining room. They eat good food like rice, meat, and fruit. People talk about their day at school or work. They listen to each other and smile.

After the meal, the family cleans the table. One person takes the dirty plates to the sink. Another person wipes the table with a cloth. This makes the kitchen clean and tidy again. Everyone works as a team.

Mealtime is a great part of daily life. It is about more than just food. Families talk, laugh, and help each other. Eating together makes a family very strong and happy.

articles.title: Family Visitors at Home
articles.summary: Family visits are special times when children eat, play games, and make happy memories together at home.
articles.passage:
Many families have nice visitors at home. Grandparents, uncles, aunts, and cousins often visit our houses. This is a very happy time for young children. First, everyone enjoys a big lunch together. Children help their parents in the kitchen. They put clean plates, forks, and cups on the table. They eat delicious food and talk about their week. Everyone smiles and laughs. Sharing a meal is a great way to start the visit.

Next, children do many fun activities together. They play nice board games on the living room floor. They also draw beautiful pictures with colorful pencils. Some children like to build big houses with toy blocks. Other children play with a small ball in the garden. Playing outside is very good for active kids. These games help children learn, share, and help each other. They laugh and have a wonderful time.

Finally, family visits make our homes very happy places. Children love to spend time with their favorite cousins. They talk, play, and make good memories at home. Working and playing together is good for everyone. Everyday visits are special and bring families closer together.

articles.title: Fun Activities for Rainy Days
articles.summary: Children can have a lot of fun playing games, drawing, and reading inside the house on rainy days.
articles.passage:
Rainy days are often wet. Children cannot play in the park. But they can have fun inside. Playing board games is very good. Children play games with their family. They play in the living room. They can play with cards. They can play with blocks. These games are exciting. They help children learn new things. Children laugh and smile. Playing games is a happy time.

Another great activity is drawing. Children can use big paper. They can use colorful crayons. They draw happy animals. They can paint nice pictures. Making art is very peaceful. Reading books is also great. Children can read funny stories. They read books about animals. They sit on a soft sofa. They use a warm blanket. Reading helps children learn. Reading is good for the brain. Books have beautiful pictures.

Wet weather is not boring. Indoor activities keep children happy. They play and read inside. These activities are good. Children do not feel sad. They have many things to do. Home is a warm place. The rain falls outside. Children love their happy home. Rainy days can be special days.

articles.title: Fun Art Time at School
articles.summary: Art class is a fun school activity where children draw, paint, and make beautiful things.
articles.passage:
Art class is a happy time at school. Children go to the art room to make beautiful things. It is a quiet and friendly place for big ideas. In this room, every child can be creative. They use many cool tools to make art. Art time helps children learn new things. It is a great hour in the school day.

First, children like to draw. They use red, blue, green, and yellow pencils. They draw houses, tall trees, and happy animals on paper. Second, painting is very fun. Children use wet paint and big brushes. They paint colorful pictures of the sky and the sun. Third, children love to make things. They use clean paper, safe glue, and small boxes. They make beautiful toys and small cars.

In short, art class is very good for young students. Children can draw, paint, and build with their hands. This special time helps them think and learn. They can show their beautiful art to their friends and family. Every school has art time because it is important. It is a wonderful activity for every young student.

articles.title: Fun Art Time at School
articles.summary: Art class is a fun time at school where children draw, paint, and make paper toys.
articles.passage:
Art class is a happy time at school. Children go to the clean art room. The room has big windows and bright lights. It has long tables and blue chairs. There are many colorful things on the tables. Children see paper, pencils, and crayons. The kind art teacher welcomes the class. She helps every student make art.

First, children draw beautiful pictures on paper. They draw happy faces, tall trees, and small houses. They use many pencils and crayons. Next, the children paint with water and brushes. They like red, blue, and yellow paint. They paint big flowers and warm suns. Then, they make cool paper toys. They use scissors and clean white glue. They make small boxes and cute paper animals. It is exciting to make new things.

Art class is good for children. They learn to use their hands. They learn to use their minds. They can create new ideas. They show their pictures to their parents. They also show them to their friends. They put their toys in their rooms. Art time makes every student happy. It is a wonderful part of school.

articles.title: Fun at the Riding School
articles.summary: Children learn to ride and care for horses safely at a riding school.
articles.passage:
A riding school is a busy place. Many children go there to see horses. A horse is a big, strong animal. It has four legs and a tail. Horses have big eyes and ears. Learning about horses is very fun. Safety is very important at the school. Children must walk slowly near the horse. Do not run or make loud noises. Stand where the horse can see you. This helps the horse stay very calm.

Children also learn to care for horses. They use a brush for the hair. This makes the horse feel very good. You can also give the horse water. Horses like to eat green grass. It is important to be kind. Now it is time to ride. A teacher helps the children stay safe. Wear a riding hat on your head. The riding hat is very hard. Sit tall and hold the long ropes. The horse walks slowly on the grass.

Riding schools are great for children. You can learn many things about horses. We must listen to the teacher. You must be careful and very kind. Horses are very good friends for everyone. They are beautiful and we love them.

articles.title: Healthy Snacks for Energy
articles.summary: Healthy snacks like fruit, nuts, and yogurt give your body the best energy for school and play.
articles.passage:
Your body needs energy every day. You play, run, and learn at school. Healthy snacks can help your body. They give you good energy to play. Fresh fruit is a great snack. You can eat a sweet yellow banana. You can also eat a red apple. These fruits have many good vitamins. The vitamins keep your body very strong. They also help you grow well.

Nuts are another great snack for you. Small nuts have a lot of power. They help your brain work at school. You can also choose fresh white yogurt. Yogurt is good for your teeth. It is also good for your bones. Some children like to drink cold milk. These simple snacks keep you full. They help you run very fast. They are good for active children.

It is easy to choose healthy snacks. You must not eat many sweet candies. Sweet candies do not give long energy. You can drink fresh water too. Water is very good for you. You can drink it with snacks. Good snacks make your body feel happy. They keep you happy all day long. Choose a healthy snack today!

articles.title: Healthy Teeth for You
articles.summary: Good habits like brushing and eating healthy food keep your teeth strong and your smile bright.
articles.passage:
Healthy teeth are very good for everyone. We need teeth to eat our food. We also use them to talk. Clean teeth make a very nice smile. Everyone can have strong and white teeth.

Brush your teeth every morning after breakfast. Brush your teeth every night before bed. Use a small toothbrush and some toothpaste. Move the brush in small circles. Brushing for two minutes is very good.

The food you eat is also good for teeth. Eat many green vegetables and some fruit. Milk and water are good for you. Do not eat many sweets or cake. Sugar can hurt your teeth and mouth.

Go to the dentist two times every year. The dentist looks inside your mouth. They check for any small bad holes. A dentist helps you stay very healthy and happy. They can clean your teeth very well.

Cleaning every day is good for every child. Brush your teeth and eat healthy food. Visit your dentist for a check. These simple things keep your smile bright and beautiful. You can have great teeth every day.

articles.title: Healthy Vegetables on Our Plates
articles.summary: Vegetables are colorful, tasty, and help our bodies grow strong and healthy.
articles.passage:
Vegetables are very good for our bodies. We can see them on our plates at lunch and dinner. They have many beautiful colors. One common vegetable is the carrot. Carrots are bright orange and long. They are sweet and very crunchy. Some children eat them raw in salads, and some children eat them cooked in hot soup. Carrots can help our eyes see well in the dark.

Another vegetable we often see is the tomato. Tomatoes are round, red, and juicy. We find them on pizza, in pasta, and in salads. They taste fresh and sweet. Green peas are also fun to eat at dinner. They are very small, round, and sweet. They look like little green balls on our plates. Peas grow in long green pods on a plant.

Potatoes are another vegetable we love. We can mash them, bake them, or make hot chips with them. They are white inside. All these vegetables give us great power and energy. They make our bodies strong and healthy every day. It is very good to eat many different colors on your plate. Eating vegetables is easy and good for you!

articles.title: Helpers at Home
articles.summary: Children can help their families by doing easy jobs like cleaning their bedrooms, setting the table, and feeding pets.
articles.passage:
Children can do simple jobs at home. Helping is good for families. It makes the home happy. Everyone has a job to do.

First, children can clean their bedrooms. You can put your toys in a big box. You can make your small bed. It is easy and fun. Second, you can help in the kitchen. You can put plates on the table. You can carry cups. This helps your mom and dad at dinner time.

Third, you can feed your family pets. Dogs and cats need food and clean water. You can give them food in their bowls. Helping at home is great. Simple jobs make families happy and strong.

articles.title: Helping at Home is Fun and Easy
articles.summary: Children can help their families by doing easy household chores like cleaning their rooms, helping in the kitchen, and feeding pets.
articles.passage:
Helping at home is very good. Children can do many easy jobs. These jobs help parents every day. First, children can clean their bedrooms. They can put toys in a big box. They can make their beds in the morning. A clean room is nice and safe. Parents are very happy with clean rooms. It is a very good habit.

Second, children can help in the kitchen. They can put plates on the table. They can also set the forks and spoons. After dinner, they can clean the table. Third, children can help with the pets. They can give clean water to the dog. They can put food in the cat's bowl. Pets need fresh food every morning and night. Taking care of animals is very important. These jobs are fun and simple.

In summary, helping at home is great. It teaches children to be very helpful. You can do three easy jobs today. You can clean, set tables, and feed pets. Doing chores makes a family very strong. Everyone in the house feels happy. Your parents will smile because you help. You can help your family right now.

articles.title: How a Seed Grows
articles.summary: A seed needs water, soil, and sunlight to grow into a plant.
articles.passage:
A seed is very small. It looks like a little stone. But a seed is alive. It needs help to grow. First, a seed needs water. Rain falls on the ground. The seed drinks the water. The water makes the seed soft. Now the seed can open. A tiny root goes down into the earth. It is the start of a new life.

Next, the seed needs good soil. Soil is the brown dirt. It has food for the plant. The root grows deep in the soil. It holds the plant in place. Then, the seed needs sunlight. The sun is hot and bright. It gives energy to the plant. A small green leaf comes out. It looks for the sun in the sky. The leaf is very thin and soft.

The leaf grows big and strong. Now the seed is a small plant. It has roots, a stem, and green leaves. It needs water every day. It needs the warm sun every day. Growing a plant is very fun. You can watch a seed grow in a pot. It is a very cool thing to see. Nature is amazing and beautiful. Plants help the world.

articles.title: How a Seed Grows
articles.summary: A seed needs soil, water, and sunlight to grow from the ground into a small green plant.
articles.passage:
A small seed is like a little baby. It sleeps in the dark ground. The seed is very quiet and small. But this small seed can do big things. It wants to grow. It wants to become a nice green plant. How does a small seed do this? Let us look.

A seed needs three main things to grow. First, the seed needs good soil. The dark soil is the seed's home. It holds the seed safe. Second, the seed needs clean water. Water comes from the rain or a watering can. It makes the seed soft and strong. Third, the seed needs light. Warm light comes from the big yellow sun. The sun helps the seed make its food.

Now, the seed can wake up. Small white roots go down into the ground. They drink water from the soil. Next, a tiny green stem goes up. It comes out of the dark ground. It looks for the warm sun. Now, we can see a beautiful baby plant. It is happy in the garden. This is how a seed grows.

articles.title: How Clouds Help Us
articles.summary: We can look at the color of clouds to know the weather.
articles.passage:
Look up at the blue sky. What do you see there? You can see many soft clouds. Clouds are beautiful and very useful. They can help us guess the weather. Some clouds are small and white. They look like soft white sheep. These white clouds mean nice weather. The sun is warm and bright. You can play outside with friends. You can play soccer or ride a bike. You can have a fun picnic.

Other clouds are grey and dark. Grey clouds mean a different day. They carry a lot of water. These clouds cover the yellow sun. They block the bright light. You see grey clouds and rain comes. You must take your big umbrella. Sometimes clouds are big and black. These black clouds can mean a storm. You can hear the loud wind. You can see the fast rain. It is best to stay inside. You can read a book.

Now you know about the clouds. They are like a big map. The sky tells us many things. We can look up every morning. We see the white or grey clouds. Then we can plan our day. We know when to take an umbrella. We know when to play outside. Clouds are great friends in the sky.

articles.title: How Police Officers Keep Us Safe
articles.summary: Police officers help keep our streets safe by watching traffic, helping children cross roads, and patrolling the town.
articles.passage:
Police officers are important helpers in our community. They work on the streets every day. Their job is to keep everyone safe. One way they help is with traffic. They watch the cars on the big road. They make sure drivers do not go too fast. Slow cars are safe cars. Officers help when there is a car accident. They help everyone and make the road safe again.

Police officers also help people cross the street. They often stand near schools in the morning. They wear bright yellow or green jackets. Drivers can see them easily. When children want to cross, the officer stops the cars. This helps children get to school safely. Officers also help people who are lost. They help you find your family. They are very friendly and kind to children.

In the night, officers drive around the town. They watch the shops and houses. They look for any problems. They make sure everything is quiet and safe. We can feel happy because they work hard. Police officers do a very good job. They keep our streets safe for everyone. We can smile and say hello when we see them.

articles.title: How to Be a Great Helper at Home
articles.summary: Children can help their families by cleaning their rooms, helping in the kitchen, and caring for pets.
articles.passage:
Many people live in a house. Every family has many small jobs. Children can help their parents every day. This makes the home a happy place. It is good to work together. A child can clean their bedroom. You can put your toys in a big box. You can also make your bed in the morning. A clean room looks very nice. It helps you find your things quickly.

The kitchen is a busy place. Children can help before dinner. You can wash some red apples or green grapes. You can put the plates on the table. Helping in the kitchen is fun for everyone. Do you have a pet or a garden? You can give fresh water to your dog. You can also give food to a small cat. Some children water the plants in the garden. This helps the flowers grow big and beautiful.

Small jobs are important for every family. Helping at home teaches children new things. It also makes your mother and father very happy. Every child can be a great helper at home today. Working together makes a family strong. It is good to do your best every day. Helping at home is a very kind thing to do.

articles.title: Learning to Dance
articles.summary: A dance class is a fun place to learn new steps and make friends.
articles.passage:
Dance is a very fun hobby. Many children go to dance classes. A dance class is a happy place. You can learn to move your body. Boys and girls join the class. Children wear comfortable clothes to class. They wear soft shoes on their feet. They also bring a big water bottle. Dancing can make you very thirsty! You need to drink lots of water.

A dance teacher helps the class. The teacher is very nice and friendly. The teacher shows you new steps. You watch the teacher very carefully. Then, you try the steps too. Sometimes the steps are very easy. Sometimes the steps are a bit hard. But you can always try again. The class listens to loud music. You step to the left and right. You jump up and down the room. Children dance with their new friends. Everyone moves together in a long line.

It is fun to dance together. Learning to dance is a great idea. It makes your legs and arms strong. You learn to listen to the music. You can practice the steps at home. You can show your family your dance. Dance classes are good for every child. You can smile and have great fun.

articles.title: Learning with School Computers
articles.summary: School computers help students find information, type stories, and make creative school projects.
articles.passage:
Many schools have a special computer room. It is a very busy and fun place. Students go there every week with their class. They sit at big tables and use the computers to learn. The computer screens are bright and colorful. This room is very useful for modern school work.

First, students can find interesting facts on the internet. They can look at nice pictures of wild animals and read about old towns. It is easy to find answers for science homework. Second, children can write stories on the computer. They type words on the clean keyboard. They can make the words big and choose pretty colors. Third, students can make projects. They draw maps and make simple slides for a presentation. They can work in small groups and talk about their ideas.

In summary, school computers are great tools. They help young students learn about the world every day. They make doing school projects very easy and exciting. Children like to use computers with their teachers and classmate friends. It is a wonderful way to study.

articles.title: Leo and Luna's Big Quiz
articles.summary: Leo, a boy who loves animals, goes on a TV quiz with his toy owl Luna and wins by answering a difficult question.
articles.passage:
Leo is a happy boy. He loves all animals. He has a toy owl. Her name is Luna. Luna is very wise. Every evening, Leo watches a TV quiz. It is about jungle animals. He likes to guess answers. Leo wants to be on the show. His mum helps him. They send a letter. The TV show says 'yes'! Leo feels very excited. He will go to the studio tomorrow.

Today is the big day. Leo goes to the TV studio. His mum is with him. It is a very big place. There are many bright lights. Leo sees other children. He feels a little nervous. The quiz master smiles at Leo. He asks the first question. 'What animal eats bananas?' Leo thinks hard. 'A monkey!' he says. This is easy! He answers three more questions. But then a very hard question comes.

The quiz master asks, 'What color is a polar bear's skin?' Leo looks at Luna. Luna is in his pocket. He remembers a picture book. He read it last week. 'Black!' Leo says loudly. The quiz master claps his hands. 'That is correct, Leo!' he says. Leo wins the animal quiz! He gets a big new toy animal. He also gets a special book. Leo is very happy. He tells Luna, 'You helped me!' They go home now.

articles.title: Leo Helps at the Shop
articles.summary: Leo helps his mother in her sandwich shop and makes a customer happy.
articles.passage:
Leo is a small boy. He is in the shop today. The shop is very clean and bright. His mum makes food there. She makes big sandwiches for everyone. Many people come to the shop today. They want to eat a good lunch. Mum is very busy now. She has many things to do. She is very tired.

Leo wants to help his mum. He has a red hat on his head. He goes to the kitchen. He sees the long bread on the table. He sees the red tomatoes and yellow cheese. Leo makes a new sandwich. He puts the cheese on the bread. He puts the tomatoes on the bread too. It is a very big sandwich. He works slowly and carefully.

A girl comes into the shop. She is very hungry. Leo gives her the special sandwich. The girl eats the food. "This sandwich is very good!" she says. Mum looks at Leo and she smiles. She is very happy. Leo is happy too. Luna the Owl watches them from a tree. "You are a great helper, Leo!" says Luna. It is a very good day at the shop.

articles.title: Leo's Big Sandwich
articles.summary: Leo helps his mum make a delicious sandwich in her busy shop with the help of Luna the owl.
articles.passage:
Leo is a very happy boy. He lives in a clean and beautiful town. His mum has a popular sandwich shop. The shop is always busy. Today, many hungry people come to the shop. Leo wants to help his mum. Mum is baking fresh bread. Luna, the clever learning owl, sits on a high shelf. Luna says, "You can do it, Leo!" Leo smiles. He washes his hands quickly.

Leo walks to the clean table. He takes two big pieces of white bread. First, he puts yellow cheese on the bread. Next, he adds some red tomatoes and green lettuce. He works very slowly and carefully. Luna flies down to the table. She looks at the fresh sandwich. "This is a great sandwich!" says Luna. Mum looks at Leo and smiles. She is very proud.

A little girl comes into the warm shop. She sees the big sandwich on the table. "I want that sandwich, please!" she says. Mum puts the sandwich in a small bag. The girl buys the food. She takes a big bite and smiles. "This is very delicious!" she says. The girl is happy. Leo and his mum are happy too. Leo wants to help tomorrow, too.

articles.title: Leo's Big Volcano
articles.summary: A boy named Leo makes a red volcano for his science class and everyone is happy.
articles.passage:
Leo is a young boy at school. Today is a big day for him. It is science class today. Leo wants to make a big volcano. He has a box and some paper. He uses glue to make a mountain. Luna the Learning Owl is there. She watches Leo work at his desk. He paints the mountain brown. It looks like a real mountain now.

Leo puts a bottle inside the mountain. He adds some white soap. Then he takes some red juice. He pours the juice into the bottle. Luna the Owl says, 'Look at that!' The red liquid goes up fast. It comes out of the top. It looks like hot red lava. The red juice runs down the side. It is a big mess but it is fun.

The teacher comes to his desk. She sees the red volcano. 'This is a great volcano, Leo!' she says. Leo is very happy now. His friends see the volcano too. They clap their hands and smile. Leo loves his science class. He wants to be a scientist. Luna the Owl flies away. Science is very exciting today.

articles.title: Leo's Blue Plane
articles.summary: Leo builds a blue model plane, but it does not fly well until he remembers his toy owl Luna's advice about balance and fixes it, making him and his dog Max very happy.
articles.passage:
Leo loved planes very much. He wanted a big blue plane. Today he will build one with his hands. Leo has many plane parts in a box. He worked in his room all morning. Max, his happy brown dog, sat near him quietly. Max liked to watch Leo work and build things. Leo carefully put the small parts together. He used glue and small tools to fix them. Soon, it was a beautiful model plane. The plane was bright blue and red. Leo was very happy with his new plane. "Tomorrow I will fly my cool plane!" he said to Max. Max barked softly, happy too. 

Yesterday Leo went to the big green park. Max came with him to play and run. The sun was warm and bright in the sky. Leo held his new blue plane with excitement. "Fly, my plane, fly high!" he said loudly. He threw the plane into the air with all his power. But it did not fly well. It went up a little bit, then it came down very fast. It fell hard on the soft green grass. Leo tried one more time. Again, the plane fell down quickly. It could not fly high or far. Leo was very sad now. His big smile went away. Max looked at the plane. Max was sad too for his friend Leo. 

Leo sat on the ground for a minute. He thought about the plane problem. He remembered his wise toy owl, Luna. Luna always said, "Good balance makes things fly far and well!" Leo looked closely at his plane's wings. "Ah, maybe it needs good balance," he thought with a new idea. He moved a small wing part a little bit. He made it better and stronger. Then Leo stood up tall and smiled. He threw the plane one last time. The blue plane went very high up. It flew smoothly in the big sky like a bird. Max ran fast under it, jumping up. Leo laughed loudly and smiled big. He was very, very happy. His blue plane could now fly!

articles.title: Leo's Broken Bike
articles.summary: Leo's bike is broken, but his dad helps him fix the chain so Leo can ride it again.
articles.passage:
Leo has a bright red bike. He loves his bike very much. Every morning, he rides it outside. Today, Leo wants to play in the park. He goes to get his bike from the garage. Oh no! The bike wheel is stuck. The metal chain is off its place. Leo looks at it closely. He tries to put the chain back. His small fingers push and pull. But the chain does not move. It is a big problem. Leo feels very sad. He really wants to ride his bike today.

Dad comes into the garage. He sees Leo sitting on the floor. "What is wrong, Leo?" Dad asks. Leo points to his bike wheel. "My bike is broken," Leo says. "I cannot ride it to the park." Dad bends down. He looks at the bike's chain. "This is not a big problem," Dad says kindly. "We can fix it together." Dad smiles at Leo. "First, we need some tools." Dad goes to his workshop. He comes back with a big, blue tool box.

Dad opens the blue tool box. He takes out a small wrench. "Hold the bike steady, please," Dad tells Leo. Leo holds the bike tightly. Dad starts to work on the chain. He turns a screw here. He pushes the chain there. It is a little bit difficult. Leo watches his dad carefully. Soon, the chain is back on the wheel! "Try it now, Leo," Dad says. Leo moves the pedals. The wheel turns easily! "Hooray!" Leo shouts loudly. He gives Dad a big, happy hug. Now Leo can ride his bike to the park. He will play with his friends tomorrow.

articles.title: Leo’s First Goal
articles.summary: Leo is happy because he kicks the ball into the net and scores his first goal.
articles.passage:
Leo has a big ball. He is at the park today. He wants to play football. Leo likes sports. But he is sad. He never scores a goal. Luna the Learning Owl flies down. Luna is wise and kind. She looks at Leo. "Do not be sad," Luna says. "You can play well. Just look at the net and kick." Leo smiles. He is ready to try.

Leo runs fast now. He has the ball. The grass is green and soft. He kicks the ball with his foot. The ball moves quickly. It goes past the other children. Leo is very excited. He sees the big white net. He thinks about the goal. Luna the Learning Owl watches him. "Go, Leo, go!" she calls out. Leo hits the ball again. It is a very strong kick.

The ball goes into the net! It is a goal! Leo jumps up and down. He is very happy. His friends shout and clap their hands. "Great job, Leo!" they say. Leo scores his first goal today. He loves his team. Luna the Learning Owl is happy too. She flies back to her tree. Leo wants to play more. Football is a great game. He will play again tomorrow.

articles.title: Leo's Yummy Garden Soup
articles.summary: Leo wants to make soup from his garden vegetables, and his mom helps him cook a delicious meal.
articles.passage:
Leo loved soup very much. Today was Saturday. He wanted to make some soup for lunch. He thought, "I will make vegetable soup." He put on his small blue shoes. Then he went to his green garden. In the garden, Leo saw many vegetables. He saw two big orange carrots. He saw three red tomatoes. He saw some round brown potatoes. And he saw one big white onion. He picked all these vegetables carefully. He put them in his yellow basket. He was happy. He carried the full basket back home.

Leo came inside his kitchen. He wanted to start cooking now. But he did not know how to make soup. It was a big problem for him. "Mom!" he called loudly. His mom came to the kitchen. "What is it, Leo?" she asked. Leo said, "I want to make soup. Can you help me, please?" Mom smiled a big smile. "Yes, I can help you," she said. "We will make yummy soup." First, Mom showed Leo how to wash the vegetables. Leo washed them with water. Then Mom helped him cut them. Leo cut the carrots and tomatoes into small pieces. They put all the small pieces in a big pot. Mom added clean water. Then they put the pot on the cooker. Mom said, "We will cook the soup now."

Soon, the kitchen smelled very good. The soup was warm and ready. "Look, Leo!" Mom said. "Our soup is ready!" Leo was very excited. He and Mom sat at the table. They ate the warm, yummy soup. Leo loved his soup. He loved cooking with Mom. He will make soup again tomorrow.

articles.title: Lily and the Magic Paintbrush
articles.summary: Lily has a magic paintbrush that brings her drawings to life, but she learns to be careful when a painted dragon causes a small problem.
articles.passage:
Lily is a happy little girl. She lives in a small, warm house. Lily loves to draw and paint many pictures. She has a very special paintbrush. It is an old, green brush. Her grandmother gave it to her last year. Today, Lily wants to paint a new picture. She will paint a beautiful tree in a sunny park. Lily dips her special brush in bright red paint. She draws a big, red flower first. The flower is very beautiful and bright. Then the painted flower moves a little! Lily opens her eyes wide. "Wow!" she says quietly. "My brush is magic!" She feels very excited and happy.

Next, Lily paints a small, green dragon. It is a very friendly dragon. The dragon has big, shiny eyes. It has a long, happy tail. It also has small, blue wings. Suddenly, the dragon jumps from the paper! It flies fast around Lily's warm room. "Oh no!" says Lily. The little dragon is very quick. It eats her sweet red apple from the table. Then it sits on her soft bed and starts to sing. Lily smiles, but she feels a little sad too. This dragon is very lively. It will make a big mess. She wants her friendly dragon back inside its picture.

Lily asks, "What can I do now?" Luna the owl comes to her window. Luna is a very wise and kind owl. "Paint a fun, new place," Luna says softly. "Give the dragon a good home." Lily thinks hard and takes her brush again. She paints a big, blue sky. She paints big, white, fluffy clouds. She paints a tall, green mountain under the sun. The little dragon looks at the new mountain picture. It flies to the picture very fast. It sits on the tall mountain happily. Lily is very happy now. Her special brush makes magic, but she must be careful. She will paint good, careful pictures every day.

articles.title: Lily Dances at the Sunny Town Party
articles.summary: Lily was shy to dance at Sunny Town's music party, but Luna the owl helped her find courage, and she danced happily with her friends.
articles.passage:
Today was a very happy day. Sunny Town had a big party. It was a music day! Lily and Tom are good friends. They love to hear music. The big yellow sun was bright in the sky. Many people were in the street. Parents and children were here. Everyone was smiling and talking. They will dance and sing all afternoon. They had nice food to eat and cool drinks too. It was a super day.

A big stage was in the park. Red and blue and green flags were flying high. Musicians came to the stage. The music started. It was a very loud and happy song. Tom danced very well. He liked to jump and spin. But Lily was not dancing. She stood quietly with her small brown dog, Max. Max was wagging his tail. Lily wanted to dance too. She could see her friends dancing. But she felt a little bit shy. Luna the big white owl flew down from a tall tree. Luna saw Lily. Luna said, "Hello, Lily! Why are you quiet? You can dance!"

Lily looked at Tom. Tom waved his hand to her. He smiled at Lily. Luna gave Lily a small red flower. "This flower is for courage, Lily," Luna said softly. Lily put the pretty flower in her hair. She felt strong and happy now. She took Tom's hand. They walked to the big stage. They started to jump and turn around. They clapped their hands to the music. They sang the happy song. All their friends danced and laughed with them. What a super fun day for Sunny Town! Tomorrow they will tell their family about this.

articles.title: Lily's Big Concert Day
articles.summary: Lily is scared to play the piano at her school concert, but her friend Luna the owl helps her practice, and Lily plays beautifully, making her very happy.
articles.passage:
Lily is a little girl. She loves music very much. She plays the big piano at home. Tomorrow is a big day for her. It is the school concert. Lily will play her favorite song. She will play for all her friends. But Lily feels a little scared. Many people will listen to her music. She sees many happy faces in her mind. Her small hands are a little cold. She sits near her window. "Oh dear," she says sadly. "I feel very bad now."

Then, Luna the Learning Owl came to visit. Luna is a clever brown owl. She sees Lily's sad face. "Hello, Lily!" Luna says very softly. "Why are you sad today, my friend?" Lily looks up at Luna. "I will play piano tomorrow," Lily tells her. "I am scared of the big stage and many people." Luna smiles kindly. "You play music very well, Lily. I can help you now." They practice the song together. Luna sings a little song. Lily plays the notes slowly and carefully. Luna claps her soft wings. "Very good, Lily!" Luna says. "You can really do this." Lily feels a little better then.

Today is the exciting concert day. Lily went to school early. Her mom and dad were there to watch. She saw many smiling friends. Lily walked slowly onto the stage. She sat at the big black piano. She closed her eyes for one moment. She remembered Luna's kind words. Lily started to play her beautiful song. The music was sweet and clear. Everyone listened very carefully. They smiled and clapped their hands together. Lily finished her nice song. She stood up proudly. Everyone clapped very, very loudly. Lily felt very happy and proud. She saw Luna outside the window. Luna winked at her. It was a very good day for Lily.

articles.title: Lily's First Ballet Dance
articles.summary: Lily goes to her first ballet class, finds it a little hard, but feels happy and determined to practice more.
articles.passage:
Lily loves pink dresses. She loves happy music. Today was a very special day. Lily went to her first ballet class. Her mum smiled at her. Lily wore a new pink dress. She put on her small pink ballet shoes. "Have fun, Lily!" said her mum. Lily walked into a big, bright room. Many girls were there. They all wore pink dresses and little shoes. Lily felt a little shy. She saw a friendly girl with brown hair.

The teacher had a big, kind smile. "Hello, children!" she said. "My name is Miss Anna. Let's dance now!" The music started. It was very soft and slow. Lily tried to dance. She lifted her right leg up. She moved her left arm out. It was a little hard. Her feet felt a bit heavy. Other girls jumped high. Some girls turned very fast. Lily watched them carefully. She wanted to dance well like them. She tried very, very hard to move her body. She did not stop.

The ballet class ended quickly. Lily said "Goodbye" to Miss Anna. "You did very well, Lily," said Miss Anna. "You can dance! Just keep trying every day." Lily smiled a big smile. She felt happy now. She went home with her mum. Tomorrow, Lily will practice at home. She will listen to music and dance more in her room. She wants to be a good ballet dancer. Lily knows she can do it. She will try again and again. It was a good first day. She loves ballet!

articles.title: Lily's Special Cookies
articles.summary: Lily wanted to bake cookies but used salt instead of sugar, making them salty, but with help from Luna the owl, she learned to read recipes carefully.
articles.passage:
Lily wanted to bake cookies today. She loved to eat them. Her mum was out. Lily thought, "I will make a surprise for my family!" She went to the kitchen. It was big and clean. Lily found a new recipe book. It had many bright pictures. She wanted to make sweet chocolate cookies. This sounded fun.

Lily got a big, blue bowl. She put in white flour. She added two small eggs. Then she opened a white box. She thought it was white sugar. But it was salt! Lily put in much salt. She mixed it all with a big spoon. The mix looked good. Lily made small balls of dough. She put them on a big tray. She put the tray in the hot oven. She waited and waited.

After ten minutes, the cookies were ready. They smelled very hot. Lily took one cookie. She bit it. "Oh, no!" she cried. The cookie was very, very salty. It was not sweet at all. Lily felt so sad. Her friend, Luna the Learning Owl, flew to her. "What is wrong, Lily?" Luna asked. Lily showed Luna the bad cookie. "I made a big mistake," Lily said. "I put in salt, not sugar!" Luna looked at the recipe book. "Always read the words well," Luna said. "And ask for help next time." Lily smiled. "Yes, Luna," she said. "Tomorrow, I will read well. I will make sweet cookies!"

articles.title: Lily's Special Dancing Shoes
articles.summary: Lily loves to dance but her old shoes are not good, so her mum buys her new, shiny pink dancing shoes that make her feel like a star.
articles.passage:
Lily is a little girl. She loves to dance very much. Every day, after school, she dances in her room. She puts on her favourite music. Lily moves her arms and her feet. She dreams of being a super dancer. But her old shoes are not good. They are big and look tired. They are not soft and bright for her little feet. Lily feels a little sad about her shoes. She wants very special dancing shoes.

One sunny morning, Lily's mum came into her room. Mum watched Lily try to dance. "Your shoes are very old now," Mum said gently. "We will go to the big shoe shop today, my dear." Lily felt very excited to hear this. At the shop, Lily saw many beautiful shoes. There were red shoes, blue shoes, and bright pink shoes. Then she saw special, shiny pink shoes. They were soft and felt light. Lily liked them very much. She put the new shoes on her feet. They felt warm and happy.

Lily smiled a very big smile. "Oh, Mum! These shoes are perfect!" she said loudly. Mum smiled back. She bought the new dancing shoes for Lily. Lily took her happy new shoes home. Today, she put on her special shoes again. She turned on her happy music. Lily danced and jumped and turned around. Her new shoes helped her move easily. She felt like a dancing star. Tomorrow, Lily will go to her dance class. She will show her nice new shoes to her friends. Lily is very happy with her special shoes.

articles.title: Luna and the Museum's Secret Stars
articles.summary: Leo and Mia went to a big museum with Luna the owl, found secret stars that led them to a robot in a space room, and learned new things.
articles.passage:
Leo and Mia were very happy today. It was a sunny day. They went to the big city museum. Their good friend, Luna the clever owl, came with them. Luna loves to learn new things and help children. "Look, friends!" said Luna. "Many old and interesting things are here." They walked past tall, stone statues. They saw very old clothes from a long time ago.

Then they went to a big dinosaur room. The dinosaur bones were so, so big! "Can a dinosaur eat a car?" asked Leo. Mia laughed. Luna told them, "No, this dinosaur ate plants many years ago." Next, they went to a bright room. Many colorful pictures were on the wall. Mia saw a small, shining star on one picture. "What is this little star, Luna?" she asked. Luna smiled with her big eyes. "It is a secret star, Mia. You must find three more stars to open a secret door."

Leo and Mia started to look carefully. They looked on a big map. They looked under an old clock. Mia found a second bright star near a window. Leo found the third star inside a small, open box. The stars showed a way. They led to a quiet, new room. Inside, a friendly robot waited. The robot said, "Hello, clever children! Welcome to the space room." It showed them pictures of the moon and shiny space rocks. Leo and Mia were very excited. They learned about space and had a fun, secret adventure. They will tell Mum and Dad about it tomorrow.

articles.title: Making a Fresh Fruit Salad
articles.summary: Making a fruit salad with an adult is a safe, fun, and healthy activity.
articles.passage:
A fruit salad is a healthy food. It is easy to make at home. You can make it with an adult. Your mom or dad can help you. This is a safe and fun activity. First, choose your favorite sweet fruits. You can use red apples. You can use yellow bananas. You can also use nice green grapes. You can add sweet oranges too.

First, wash the fruit with cold water. Clean fruit is very good to eat. Next, the adult cuts the fruit. They use a sharp kitchen knife. You must not use a knife alone. Kids must be safe in the kitchen. Put the clean fruit in a bowl. Mix the sweet fruit with a spoon. It looks very colorful and nice. It has many beautiful colors.

Finally, your fresh fruit salad is ready. You can share it with your family. You can eat it for lunch. You can eat it after school. It is a sweet and healthy snack. Preparing fruit salad is very fun. It helps you learn about good food. Eat some fresh fruit every day. It is great for your body.

articles.title: Making a Sweet Fruit Salad
articles.summary: A simple fruit salad is a healthy food that you can easily make with an adult.
articles.passage:
Fruit is very good for you. You can make a fruit salad. It is a very fun food. First, you need some fresh fruit. You can choose big red apples. You can choose long yellow bananas. You also need an adult. An adult can help you today. Mothers or fathers can help you. They help you in the kitchen. Making a salad is a fun project. You can make it for lunch.

First, wash the fruit in water. Clean fruit is safe to eat. Wash the apples and bananas well. Next, the fruit is ready. An adult must use a knife. A knife is very sharp. Children do not use sharp knives. The adult cuts the red apples. They cut them into small pieces. You can peel the yellow bananas. Peeling bananas is easy to do. Then, the adult cuts the bananas. The fruit looks very nice now.

Now, put the fruit in a bowl. Use a big bowl for this. You can mix the fruit. Mix it with a big spoon. Stir the apples and bananas well. You can add sweet orange juice. The juice makes it very sweet. Now your fruit salad is ready. You can eat it with friends. It is cold and very sweet. Fruit salad is a healthy food. Making food with adults is fun!

articles.title: Max and the School Play
articles.summary: Max forgets his lines during a school play, but looking at Luna the Learning Owl helps him remember, and he and Lily finish their performance happily.
articles.passage:
Max and Lily go to school today. They are very good friends. Today is a big, special day. They will perform a school play. The play is about many forest animals. Max is a small, brown rabbit. Lily is a quick, happy squirrel. They wear funny animal costumes. They have many lines to say. Their teacher, Miss Anna, helped them. She said, "Speak loudly and clearly!" Max felt a little shy this morning. But Lily held his hand tightly. "We can do it together, Max!" Lily said. Max smiled. He felt a little brave then.

The school hall is very full now. Many parents and friends sit and watch. Bright lights shine on the big stage. Max stands there in his rabbit costume. He sees his mother and father. Max feels very nervous now. It is time for him to speak. "I am a small..." Max stops. Oh no! He forgets his very first line. His brown rabbit ears go down slowly. His voice is very quiet. He looks at Lily with big, worried eyes. Lily wants to help her friend very much. She makes a small, soft sound.

Luna the Learning Owl is a big, soft toy. She sits under a green tree prop. Max looks at Luna's big, wise eyes. He thinks about Luna from practice. Luna always seemed to say, "Remember your words! Be strong!" Suddenly, Max remembers! "I am a small, friendly rabbit!" he says loudly. His voice is strong and clear now. Lily smiles big at her friend. She says her quick squirrel lines well. Max and Lily act together happily. They finish their fun animal story. Everyone claps very, very loudly. Max and Lily are very happy friends. They feel very proud now. They will talk about this fun day again tomorrow!

articles.title: Maya and Sam's Beach Treasure
articles.summary: Two friends, Maya and Sam, use an old map to find a small box of beautiful shells, colorful stones, and a gold coin on the beach with help from Luna the Learning Owl.
articles.passage:
Maya and Sam were very good friends. Yesterday, they found a secret old map. It showed a sunny beach and a big red ‘X’. “This is a treasure map!” said Maya. “We must go find it!” Today, they went to the beach. The warm sun shone bright. Big blue waves went onto the yellow sand. They carried a small red shovel and a little blue bucket. The map said, "Walk to the big, old fishing boat." They quickly walked to the boat. It was very quiet there.

They stood near the big, old fishing boat. “The ‘X’ mark is here, Sam!” said Maya. Maya started to dig fast in the wet sand. Sam looked at the map again very carefully. “Wait, Maya!” he called. “The map says ‘look under the big gray rock’.” They saw a very big, gray rock. It was next to the old boat. They tried to push the rock. It was too heavy for them. “Oh no,” said Maya. “We cannot move it. We cannot get the treasure.” Suddenly, Luna the Learning Owl flew down. She sat on the big rock. “Hoo hoo! Hello, friends!” she said. “Sometimes treasure is not big. Look for small things.”

Luna pointed a wing to the dry sand. “Look right here,” she said gently. Maya and Sam looked at the sand again. Near the big rock, they saw something. It was a small, brown wooden box. It was a little bit old. “A box!” cried Sam. “We found it!” They quickly dug all around it. Then they carefully pulled the box out. Maya opened the lid slowly, slowly. Inside were many shiny white shells and smooth, colorful stones. And a gold coin! “Wow!” they both said together. “This is a beautiful, real treasure!” They put the shells and stone in their small bucket. They smiled and walked home. It was a wonderful and happy day for the two good friends.

articles.title: Reading Comic Books for Fun
articles.summary: Reading comic books after school is a fun and easy hobby that helps children learn with colorful pictures.
articles.passage:
Reading is a very good hobby. Many children read comic books after school. These books are fun and colorful. They have many nice pictures. Children can relax with a good comic book. It is a great way to rest. You can sit on a soft chair and enjoy.

First, comic books have great drawings. The drawings show the story. You can see the happy faces. You can see the fast action. This helps children understand the words easily. Second, comic books have cool heroes. Some heroes can fly high. Other heroes can run very fast. Children love these exciting characters. They look at the bright colors. Reading about brave heroes is very exciting.

articles.title: Busy Bees and Our Food
articles.summary: Bees are very important for farming because they help plants grow the food we eat every day.
articles.passage:
Bees are small animals with fast wings. They have a big job on farms. Most healthy food needs bees to grow. Farmers love bees because they help plants. Bees help plants make seeds and fruit. Without bees, our food looks very different. Bees are important for global food production now. They are the best helpers in nature.

Pollination is a simple way plants grow. A hungry bee flies to a flower. It wants to drink some sweet nectar. Yellow pollen sticks to its fuzzy legs. Then, the bee flies to another flower. The pollen falls onto the new plant. This process helps the plant make seeds. Bees move life from one flower to another. They work hard during the warm day.

Many favorite foods use this special process. Red apples and sweet strawberries need bees. Big orange pumpkins also need many bees. If bees do not visit, fruit fails. Farmers keep bee houses in their fields. This helps the bees work every day. The bees make the food very healthy. We get better food when bees help us.

Bees help the world outside the farm. They visit wild flowers in the forest. They also visit the tall green trees. When bees help plants, more seeds fall. New plants grow from these small seeds. These plants give us some clean oxygen. This keeps the environment safe and strong. Nature needs bees to stay green and healthy.

Bees are essential for our whole planet. They help us have delicious food today. We should take care of all bees. We should also protect their small homes. When we help bees, we help ourselves. Small bees do very big work now. We can plant flowers to help them. This is good for the whole world.

articles.title: Sam and the Big Red Tractor
articles.summary: Farmer Sam and Rex the Reading Dragon work together to fix a stuck tractor and harvest vegetables on the farm.
articles.passage:
Farmer Sam has a big red tractor. This tractor is very strong and fast. Every spring, Sam uses the tractor to plant seeds. The seeds are in the dark ground. Rex the Reading Dragon is a good friend. Rex flies over the green farm. "Hello Sam!" Rex says with a big smile. "Can I help you today?" Sam looks at Rex and the seeds. "Yes, you can help me plant seeds," Sam says. They work all day under the bright sun. The tractor makes a loud noise. Sam is happy because the work is fun. The tractor is a very fast machine.

The vegetables grow big and tall in the field. Now it is time to harvest the food. Sam brings the big red tractor again. He wants to pick carrots and brown potatoes. But suddenly, the big red tractor stops moving. "Oh no!" Sam cries. "The tractor is stuck in the mud." Rex the Reading Dragon looks at the big wheels. The tractor is very heavy and the mud is deep. "Don't worry, Sam," Rex says. "I have a good idea. We can work together to move it." Rex pulls and Sam pushes the tractor.

The big red tractor moves out of the mud. Sam and Rex are very tired now. They use the tractor to finish the harvest. The tractor carries many boxes of vegetables. They take the vegetables to the big market. Sam gives Rex a bag of sweet carrots. "Thank you for your help, Rex," Sam says. "You are a very good friend." Rex eats a carrot and he smiles. Working on the farm is hard work. But it is better when friends help each other. The big red tractor is ready for tomorrow. Sam and Rex feel very proud today.

articles.title: A Garden Party for Toys
articles.summary: Lily has a wonderful tea party in her garden with her doll, teddy bear, and toy dragon, who help her save the party when the wind blows.
articles.passage:
Lily had a happy idea on a sunny day. She decided to make a beautiful tea party in her green garden. She carried a big blue box outside to the grass. Inside the box were her favorite friends. There was a lovely doll with gold hair, a soft brown teddy bear, and a small green toy dragon named Rex. Lily put a red cloth on the grass and carefully set up tiny pink cups and white plates. She also put sweet cookies on a plate.

Soon, the party started. Lily sat on the grass with her happy toys. She talked to the doll and the teddy bear. Suddenly, a strong wind blew through the trees. The wind was very fast and loud. The tiny pink cups began to slide on the red cloth. One cup fell into the green grass, and another cup almost rolled away. Oh no! The lovely tea party was in trouble. Lily could not hold all the toys and the cups at the same time.

But Rex the dragon was a very helpful toy. Rex had big, strong toy feet that could hold the red cloth down. Lily quickly placed Rex on the edge of the cloth. Then, she used the soft teddy bear to block the wind. With their help, the wind could not blow the cups away anymore. Lily laughed and thanked her smart friends. They sat together in the safe garden, ate sweet cookies, and had the best tea party ever.
