"We must work together," Mia said. "Let's make a pizza that has everything!" Leo agreed, and they started to roll the soft dough. First, they spread the red tomato sauce. Then, they sprinkled the white cheese on top. Suddenly, Leo dropped the cup of green peppers on the floor. "Oh no!" Leo cried. "We do not have enough green vegetables now!" Rex the Dragon walked over to their table. He pointed to some fresh broccoli and green peas. "Do not worry," Rex whispered. "These green vegetables are also wonderful for pizza." Mia and Leo washed the new vegetables. They decided to make a face on the pizza. They used the tomatoes for the nose and the green peas for the eyes.

They put their pizza in the hot oven. Soon, a wonderful smell filled the kitchen. When the bell rang, Rex tasted all the pizzas. Finally, he came to Mia and Leo's table. "This pizza looks like a happy friend," Rex laughed. He took a bite and smiled. "It is very delicious, and the vegetables are sweet!" At the end of the competition, Rex gave them the "Best Teamwork" cup. Mia and Leo were very happy. They learned that when they work together, they can solve any problem and make something wonderful.

articles.title: The Great World Picnic
articles.summary: A boy named Leo learns to enjoy food from different countries after Rex the Reading Dragon encourages him to try something new.
articles.passage:
Rex the Reading Dragon was at the park. It was a beautiful and sunny day. Many families were there for a big picnic. They brought food from many different countries. Rex was very excited because he loves to eat. He saw his friend Leo on a blue blanket. Leo’s family had a large bowl of pasta. The pasta was yellow and it smelled like tomatoes. Leo’s neighbor, Mei, was also there with her family. They had a big plate of long noodles. Rex said, "This food is like a map of the world!"

Leo felt a little bit worried. He usually only liked to eat bread and cheese. He looked at the long noodles. He looked at the red pasta sauce. He thought the food looked very strange. Then, a new family arrived with a basket. It was full of exotic fruits from far away. There were yellow mangoes and orange papayas. There was also a bright pink fruit with green scales. "What is that?" Leo asked. Rex smiled and said, "That is a dragon fruit. It is my favorite!"

Rex told Leo that he should be brave. "If you try it, you will like it," Rex promised. Leo took a small piece of the pink fruit. He ate it and his eyes went wide. "Oh! It is very sweet and delicious!" he cried. Then, Leo tried the salty noodles and the Italian pasta. He liked all of them! All the families shared their food and laughed together. Leo was happy because he had new friends. Rex was happy too. He knew that trying new things is always a good idea. The picnic was a great success.

articles.title: The Mystery of the Hidden Island
articles.summary: Leo and Mia, with their parents, discover a beautiful secret island, find an old map with the help of Rex the Reading Dragon, and uncover hidden, colorful shells.
articles.passage:
Leo and Mia loved to go on adventures with their mom and dad. One sunny morning, their small boat sailed on the big blue sea. “Look, Dad!” Mia shouted, pointing far away. They saw something new. It was an island, green and beautiful, with tall palm trees. It had a long, white beach, which looked very inviting. Mom smiled. “This island is not on our map,” she said. Dad slowly steered the boat closer to the quiet shore. Everyone felt very excited to discover this secret place. They knew it would be a special day.

The family carefully stepped onto the soft, warm sand. The water was very clear, and they could see many colorful fish swimming near their feet. Leo quickly put on his mask and jumped in. “Look at these fish, Mia!” he called. Mia walked along the beach, collecting pretty shells. Then, she saw something strange under a big rock. It was an old glass bottle, and inside was a rolled-up piece of paper. “What is this?” Mia asked her dad. Suddenly, a friendly, green dragon flew down. It was Rex the Reading Dragon! He had kind eyes. “Hello, little friends,” Rex said softly. “That paper might be an old map, which I can read.”

Rex carefully took the paper from the bottle. He used his long finger to follow the old lines. “This map shows a special place,” Rex told them. “It says there are big, shiny shells hidden in a secret cave.” Leo and Mia looked at each other. “Let’s find them!” Leo said bravely. The family and Rex walked together, following the map which Rex was reading. They walked past tall palm trees and big rocks. Soon, they found a small cave. Inside, the biggest, most colorful shells shimmered beautifully. The family was very happy. They promised to protect the island and its wonderful treasures. They had found a new friend in Rex, too.

articles.title: The Rainbow and the Courage Stone
articles.summary: Lily and Tom follow a rainbow after a storm with Rex the dragon and find a special 'Courage Stone' that teaches them about bravery and teamwork.
articles.passage:
The big storm had just finished. Heavy rain stopped. Dark clouds moved away. Lily and Tom were inside, feeling bored. They could not play outside. They looked through the window. It was cloudy before. Now a bright sunbeam appeared. "Look, Tom!" Lily shouted happily. She always loved seeing new things. "A rainbow! It is so big!" A beautiful rainbow with seven bright colors was across the sky. It was the most colorful thing they had seen. Suddenly, a friendly green dragon flew down. It was Rex, the Reading Dragon, who often helped children learn. "Hello, brave friends!" Rex said with a kind smile. "That rainbow is amazing, isn't it? What colors do you see?"

Lily and Tom both nodded quickly. "It is so pretty!" Tom said, his eyes wide. "But where does a rainbow go? Does it touch the ground?" Rex’s eyes twinkled brightly. "If you are brave, you might find something special." Lily and Tom looked at each other with excitement. "Let's go and find out!" Lily cried. They quickly put on their rain boots. They walked out of the house into the wet garden. The grass was very green. Tiny drops of water shone like small diamonds. They started to follow the big arch of colors. They walked past tall rose bushes and small, bright flowers. The air smelled fresh after the rain. The rainbow seemed to touch the ground far away. It was near the old, big oak tree. They walked carefully, watching their steps. Rex flew slowly above them. "Look carefully for clues!" he called down.

Near the very old oak tree, which had many green leaves, they saw a small, shiny object. It was on the wet grass. It was a smooth, blue stone. The stone sparkled under the faint sunlight. It looked more beautiful than any stone they had found. "Wow!" Tom whispered, picking it up. "What a treasure!" Rex landed softly beside them. His big wings made a gentle breeze. "This little stone is a 'Courage Stone'," he explained. "It means you were brave to follow the rainbow. You worked well together. Teamwork is important for friends." Lily held the blue stone gently. She felt its coolness. They felt very happy and proud. The beautiful rainbow started to fade slowly. It became lighter until it disappeared. "We will always remember this adventure," Lily said to Tom. They thanked Rex for his help. They knew that courage and friendship lead to discoveries.

articles.title: The Sleepover Secret
articles.summary: Three friends, Lily, Sam, and Tom, have a sleepover where a magical dragon named Rex guides them through a fun treasure hunt, teaching them about teamwork and friendship.
articles.passage:
Tonight was Lily's big sleepover party! Her best friends, Sam and Tom, arrived with their sleeping bags. "Hello!" Lily shouted, very happy. They quickly put their bags in Lily's room. First, they played a fun card game on the floor. Laughter filled the room. Lily, who loved stories, then opened a big book. On the cover was Rex, a friendly reading dragon. Suddenly, Rex's picture began to sparkle! "Hello, friends!" Rex whispered. "I have a secret challenge for you. There is a hidden treasure here. If you work together, you will find it!" Rex pointed to a small riddle on a piece of old paper.

The riddle said, "I have four legs but cannot walk. You sit on me, but I have no talk." "It's a chair!" Sam exclaimed, running to the living room. They looked under all the chairs. Tom found a small, old wooden box under the biggest chair. "Look!" he said. The box was closed, and it needed a key. "Where is the key?" Lily asked, feeling excited. Rex gave them another riddle. This one was harder. It talked about a 'shiny helper' that shows the way in the dark. They thought hard. Lily remembered her small flashlight, which she used for reading under her blanket. "Maybe it is the flashlight!" she said. They looked near the flashlight.

Sam saw a little silver key tied with a string to Lily's flashlight! "Here it is!" he cried. Lily quickly unlocked the box. Inside, they found a map which showed the garden. It led them to a big tree. Under the tree, they dug a little. They found two big packets of delicious biscuits and a brand new board game! "Wow!" Tom said. They shared the biscuits and played the game for a long time. Then, they told funny stories until they were very sleepy. The next morning, they ate a special breakfast with pancakes. Rex, still sparkling a little, smiled. "Your friendship is the best treasure of all," he said. They all agreed.

articles.title: The Special Sunday Pancakes
articles.summary: On a bright Sunday morning, Lily and Tom help their parents make special pancakes, overcome a challenge with teamwork, and enjoy a delicious breakfast with their dragon friend, Rex.
articles.passage:
It was a bright and sunny Sunday morning. Lily and Tom ran to the kitchen, which was already warm. Today was special because it was pancake day! Mom put out a big blue bowl. Dad took out the flour, milk, and eggs. "We must make the biggest, best pancakes!" said Tom happily. Lily laughed. Rex, a little green dragon who loved sweet food, flew in quietly and watched them. He often came for Sunday breakfast.

First, Mom helped Lily mix the flour and milk. Lily was careful, stirring slowly. Tom added the eggs and a little sugar. "I can help, too!" he said. Dad heated the big pan. The first pancake was ready for the pan. Dad tried to flip it, but it was difficult. It went up, but then it landed on the table! Everyone giggled. "Oh dear!" said Mom. Rex gave a small, encouraging roar. "If we work together, we can make it perfect," Mom told them. They needed more practice. Lily thought, "We will try again!"

So, they all helped. Lily mixed the batter more smoothly. Tom watched Dad closely. Dad took a bigger spoon for flipping. The next pancake was round and golden brown. Then another, and another! Soon, there was a tall pile of delicious pancakes. They put butter on them. They added sweet strawberry jam and tasty blueberry jam. Everyone sat at the table. "These are the best pancakes ever!" said Lily. Tom agreed, "They are super yummy!" Even Rex had a small pancake, which he ate very quickly. Eating together was the best part of their special Sunday morning.

articles.title: The Tall Winter Snowman
articles.summary: Leo, Mia, and Rex the dragon build a tall snowman with a blue hat and a red scarf in the winter snow.
articles.passage:
It is winter now. Cold white snow falls down from the dark sky. It covers the ground and the tall green trees. Leo and Mia look out of the big glass window. They see Rex the dragon in the quiet garden. Rex is a friendly green dragon. Rex loves the winter because he loves to play. "Look at the snow!" Mia says with a big smile. Leo and Mia put on their thick red coats. They run outside to play with Rex. The cold snow is soft. Rex waves his green tail. "We can make a new friend today," Rex says. The children laugh.

"Let us build a tall snowman!" Leo says. They roll the cold snow on the white ground. Mia makes a small ball of snow. Leo rolls a bigger ball. Rex helps them because he is very strong. Rex pushes a very big ball of snow with his feet. They put the big ball on the ground. Then they put the medium ball on top. Finally, they put the small ball on the very top. Now, they have a very tall snowman. But the snowman has no face. Mia finds two small black stones. She uses them for the eyes. Leo finds a long orange carrot for the nose. The snowman looks friendly now.

Then, the cold winter wind blows. "The snowman needs clothes," Rex says. Mia runs back to the warm house. She finds a funny blue hat and a long red scarf. Mia puts the blue hat on the snowman's head. Leo puts the long red scarf around his neck. Rex adds two small brown branches for the arms. The snowman looks very happy and warm now. Rex, Leo, and Mia hold hands and dance around their tall snowman. It is a very cold day, but they are happy and warm. They love the beautiful winter.

articles.title: The Windy Kite Rescue
articles.summary: Leo and Mia fly kites on a windy day, but Leo's kite gets stuck in a tree until, with help from Rex the Reading Dragon and Mia's clever idea, they use teamwork to free it.
articles.passage:
The bright spring afternoon was very windy. Leo and Mia were at the big green park. They had brought colourful kites. Leo's kite was a big red and yellow one, which was his absolute favourite. Mia's kite was a little smaller, blue and green, like the clear sea on a sunny day. The children were feeling excited because the strong wind was perfect for flying. "My kite will fly the highest today!" Leo shouted happily, pulling the long string. Mia laughed, her eyes shining. Her blue and green kite danced beautifully in the sky, a happy star in the bright blue. Many other children were also flying their kites. Their colourful kites looked like bright, playful birds above the tall trees.

Suddenly, a very strong gust of wind came quickly. Leo was holding his kite string very tightly, but the red and yellow kite flew faster and faster. "Oh no!" he cried loudly. The kite went higher and higher, almost touching the clouds. Then, it went straight towards a very tall, old tree, which stood at the edge of the park. Swish! The kite string got tangled badly in a high, thick branch. Leo pulled and pulled with all his strength, but his favourite kite was stuck tightly. Mia stopped flying her own kite and ran quickly to help her friend. "It is really, really high!" Mia said sadly, looking up at the stuck kite. Leo felt very sad and a little angry. "We must get it back, Mia!" he insisted. Just then, Rex, a friendly reading dragon with shiny green scales, flew down gently next to them. He had big, kind eyes and a warm smile. "What is the problem, my young friends?" Rex asked softly, his voice like a gentle breeze.

Mia thought hard for a moment, her brow furrowed. "Rex, we need a very clever idea to save Leo's kite," she told the dragon. Rex smiled wisely. "If you work together, you might find the best way," he suggested gently. Mia looked at her blue and green kite again. It was smaller than Leo's, but its string was strong, and she knew how to fly it well. "I have an idea, Leo!" she said excitedly, a big smile returning to her face. "We can use my kite to gently push your kite free from the tree branch!" Leo looked surprised but hopeful. "Can we really do that, Mia?" he asked. Mia explained her clever plan simply. They carefully flew Mia's kite very close to Leo's stuck kite. It was quite difficult work, and they moved slowly, but they were a good team. Mia slowly moved her kite, and Leo watched every moment carefully. With one last, gentle push, the red and yellow kite finally came free! It fluttered down softly through the air. Leo quickly caught it in his hands. "Thank you, Mia! Thank you, Rex!" he cheered loudly. They both felt happy and very proud of their teamwork. Now, both kites could fly together, dancing beautifully in the windy spring sky, a sign of their strong friendship.

articles.title: Understanding Floods and Too Much Rain
articles.summary: Floods happen when heavy rain makes rivers overflow and covers dry land with water.
articles.passage:
A flood is when water covers land that is usually dry. This can happen in many places around the world. Sometimes, the water is only a few inches deep. Other times, the water can be very high and strong. Floods can change the way a place looks very quickly. It is important to know why they happen.

Heavy rain is the most common reason for floods. When it rains for a long time, the clouds are full of water. The rain falls onto the ground, but the ground cannot take it all. This extra water stays on top of the grass or the streets. Because there is so much rain, it starts to move and collect in low areas. This is how a flood begins.

Rivers are also a big part of why floods happen. A river is like a path for water to reach the sea. When it rains too much, the river gets very full. The water rises higher and higher until it goes over the sides. The water then flows into fields, gardens, and even houses nearby. This can be very dangerous for people and animals living there.

The type of ground also matters during a flood. Some ground is soft and can drink a lot of water. But some ground is very hard, for example, rock or a road. Water cannot go through hard ground, so it stays on top. Also, if the ground is already very wet, it cannot hold any more rain. This makes the water stay above the land and cause a flood.

In summary, floods happen because of too much rain and full rivers. They can cover dry land and change the environment. It is important to stay safe and move to high ground when a flood happens. Knowing about floods helps us prepare and protect our homes. We must always be careful with the power of water.

articles.title: Why Moving Our Bodies is Great
articles.summary: Movement helps children stay healthy by making their muscles, heart, and brain strong and active.
articles.passage:
Movement is very important for our bodies. Children need to move every day to stay healthy. When you run, jump, or play, you help your body grow. This active time makes your body strong. It also makes you feel happy and full of energy. Many children love to play sports. But simple movements are also great for you. You do not need to play in a big game. Walking to school or dancing in your room helps too. All movement is good.

First, movement makes your bones and muscles strong. When you play active games, your muscles work hard. This hard work makes them bigger and stronger. For example, climbing on a playground helps your arms. Running fast makes your legs very strong. Second, movement is good for your heart. Your heart is a special muscle inside your chest. When you move fast, your heart pumps blood quickly. This keeps your heart healthy. Third, active play helps your brain. When you move, your brain gets more fresh air. This helps you think clearly. You can study better after you play outside. It also helps you sleep well at night. Your body can rest and get ready for a new day.

In summary, movement is a simple way to stay strong. It helps your muscles, your heart, and your brain. You should try to move for one hour every day. You can ride a bicycle with your friends. You can also swim or jump rope. Choose an activity that you like. Active children grow up to be healthy adults. So, stand up, go outside, and start moving today!
